stdout:
Done. Created `docs/verification/phase_b_sonic_maximizer.md` only.

Summary:
- Inspected `docs/verification/phase_a_build_skeleton.md` (the only existing phase_a verification doc — `phase_a_cli_smoke.md` did not exist) for tone/structure, and confirmed `Source/DSP/SonicMaximizer.h` and `.cpp` exist on disk.
- The doc records the four required commands verbatim: `cmake -B cmake-build-debug -G Ninja`, `cmake --build cmake-build-debug --target AuralMaximizerPro_Standalone`, `cppcheck --enable=all Source/DSP`, and `clang-format --dry-run --Werror` on the Sonic Maximizer `.h`/`.cpp`.
- Pass/fail outcomes: cmake, ninja, cppcheck, and clang-format are **not installed** in this environment (all `command not found`), so the gates could not be executed here; the recorded pass conditions and reproducible commands are documented for any machine with the toolchain. Per AGENTS.md verification rules, I did not substitute model self-evaluation for tool output.
- Documented residual risks: RT safety of `process()` and the coefficient update sites (off-thread publish / lock-free audio-thread read), plus toolchain availability.
- Listed the three phase changed files (`Source/DSP/SonicMaximizer.h`, `.cpp`, and this doc). No source/build files were modified; `git status` confirms only the new doc was added by this task.
